# Ataraxy Call QA 100%

> Ataraxy is an applied AI agency based in Montevideo, Uruguay, serving LATAM and the US. Call QA 100% is aI-assisted quality, compliance and coaching review for human and AI calls, using the client’s scoring criteria.

## Service

- [Call QA 100%](https://qa.ataraxydigital.com/): AI-assisted quality, compliance and coaching review for human and AI calls, using the client’s scoring criteria.
- [How it works](https://qa.ataraxydigital.com/#how): The delivery process and operating model.
- [Scope and ownership](https://qa.ataraxydigital.com/#get): What the client receives and how the engagement works.
